core_research_thesis: Design and development of a solid-state lithium-sulfur battery for electric aircraft applications, focusing on minimizing polysulfide shuttle effects, ensuring safe operation at high atmospheric pressures, and maintaining high energy density
state_of_the_art_prior_art: Lithium-sulfur battery technology with liquid electrolytes
Aerospace-grade battery designs for high-pressure and high-temperature environments
proven_facts: Polysulfide shuttle effects reduce the efficiency and lifespan of lithium-sulfur batteries

The Nernst equation relates electrochemical potential to concentration and temperature
The Butler-Volmer equation models electrode kinetics in electrochemical systems

Relationship between electrode microstructure and energy density in solid-state lithium-sulfur batteries
